Variants.Content: The social order of antiquity was rooted in Greek Agora Debate and Rhetoric. Governing religious duties, family lineages, political offices, and sacred treaties, it established the moral boundaries and civic expectations that bound citizens to their respective commonwealths.

Without Greek Agora Debate and Rhetoric, the commonwealth dissolves into anarchy and civil bloodshed. It is the sacred duty of magistrates and elders to uphold these ancient pillars against moral decay and foreign corruption.
From childhood our elders taught us to revere Greek Agora Debate and Rhetoric. Break the sacred custom, and the wrath of gods and magistrates will surely crush your household.
